text: Hello everyone, this is Jessica.Welcome to my English class.In today's lesson, we will start a journey of learning computer facts.Please get your student book and worksheet ready.In today's lesson, you will read a passage about computers.At the end of the lesson, I hope you can get to know more about computers and understand how to read an expository passage.Before reading the passage, I would like to know how much you know about computers.Let's take a look at the pictures on the screen.What type of computers are they?This is a desktop computer.We usually put it on the desk and use it in an office.When we need to use a computer in other places, we can carry a laptop computer.For people who need to travel a lot, a pump top computer may seem a good choice, because they can hold it with one hand.These are types of computers.We all know that a computer is usually made up of different parts.But do you know what these parts are called?Please name different parts of a computer.You have 20 seconds to think about it.First comes the main unit.It contains all the electronics and enables a computer to work properly.Then, for the users, we need a monitor and a screen to see the words and pictures.If we want to type in information and give orders, we need a keyboard and a mouse.These are the main parts of a computer.In addition, a computer has other parts like speakers, CD rooms, and DVD rooms.We can hear sounds from a speaker.CD rooms and DVD rooms can contain a lot of information for us.I hope you can get the same answers.Now, let's do a quick quiz to see how much you remember about different parts of a computer and their uses.Please finish task one on your worksheet in half a minute.Let's start.Let's check the answers.The monitor or screen shows words and pictures.You use the keyboard for typing in information.The mouse helps you control the computer.The main unit contains all the computer's electronics.We can hear sounds from the speakers.What do you want to know about computers?Before reading the passage, please raise some questions that you have interest in.You have 20 seconds.Here are the questions some of my students have raised.When were the first computers built?Who built the first computers?How have computers changed?How can we control our computers?Oh, I think you're all good at making questions.And you're free to have your own questions.Now, please open your student's book and turn to page 55.You will have one minute to go through the passage and find out if you can have these answers in the text.Now, let's check the answers.In the 1940s.We cannot find the answer in this passage.Maybe we can turn to an encyclopedia after class.Smaller and smaller.We can use the mouse, the keyboard, and even talk to them.As the headings suggest, the passage mainly tells us facts about computers from five aspects.Now, please read the passage again and find out the main idea of each paragraph by writing the numbers 1 to 6 in the blanks on your worksheet.You will have one minute to finish Task 2.Paragraph 1 introduces the sizes of computers in different times.Paragraph 2 is about the uses of computers.Paragraphs 3 and 4 are about the relationship between humans and computers.Paragraph 5 introduces how we can talk to our computers.Paragraph 6 shows the uses of CD rooms and DVD rooms.Now, it's time for us to go into details.Please read from line 1 to line 9 and write down the size of each kind of computer.The first one has been done as a sample for you.The first computers were bigger than cars.You'll be given one minute to finish Task 3.Desktop computers are the size of televisions.Laptop computers are the size of big books.Pump top computers are like a bar of chocolate.And we have other kinds of computers.They are tiny.Tiny means very small.According to the passage, we have these computers in our houses, and we may depend on them more than we realize.Here, realize means become aware.Please read after me.Realize.Let's continue to read the second part of the passage.Please turn to Task 4.Find out what jobs computers can do by completing the mind map on your worksheet.You will have one and a half minutes to go.Computers can calculate very fast and rarely give wrong answers.Here is a new word to you.Rarely.It means hardly.Now please read after me.It's common knowledge that computers are super calculators.Common knowledge means something known by everyone.What's more?Computers can type, print and draw things.They can operate railways and fly airplanes and spaceships.Here, operate is a new word to you.It means put something forward.Since computers can do so many jobs and do them well,We call them electronic brains.Now let's move on to the next paragraph.Read from line 17 to line 26 and answer the questions.Is a computer cleverer than I am?You will be given 30 seconds.According to the writer, for the time being, the answer is no.Here, for the time being means at present.Because human brains can understand a many of things better and create new ideas.But one day in the future,computers may be able to do most things that a human can do and do them better.To better understand this paragraph,let's read from line 23 to line 26 and answer the questions.Why does the writer ask these four questions?Have we got the answers to all these questions?To make us think about how computers will affect us in the future.Not yet.Now let's continue to read the next part and find out how to control computers.Please turn to task 5 and complete the flowchart on your worksheet.You have one minute to go.Let's go.Let's move on to the last part of the passage.Read from line 33 to line 37 and answer the question.What can people do with a computer?What can people do with a DVD room?Let's check the answer.It can be used to hold millions of pages of writing and contain pictures,videos and sounds.Let's have some practice.Read the sentences and replace the underlined parts with the words or phrases in the box on your worksheet.让我们检查答案,我们正在讨论如何保护地球,在时代中。成功是根据优势和幸运的很多因素。他经历了使用电脑。她很少在她的生活中怀疑。她知道在世界上的互联网正在改变。我发现我一个小时太晚了。今天,我们已经学习了很多关于电脑。我们知道电脑有如此的强大能量。同时,写真人也讨论了人和电脑的关系。他提出了一些问题,却没有回答。请选择任何问题来回答,并提出您的观点。您应该明确地表达您的观点,并提出至少两个原因。您有两分钟才能完成任务8的工作项目。
